hypothesis: The full resource-and-project-receipt collection plus verified append has greater typical process-CPU cost than a minimal timestamp payload plus the same verified append mechanism.
design: 12 adjacent pairs, alternating minimal/full and full/minimal order; no warmup exclusion; separate new ledgers, same existing Writer implementation. Minimal has timestamp only; full adds current resources and project summary receipts. Retain every pair and error.
measured_endpoint: Per-sample monotonic and process-CPU brackets cover payload collection and Writer.append including serialization, fsync, readback and chain update. Separate collection and append stages. Directory creation/import/final ledger sealing/result persistence and scheduling logic are outside per-sample intervals.
controls: Counterbalanced pair order; same writer and filesystem; current live collector untouched. No network, installations, tracing, other-process contents, secret reads, stress workload or denied-path fallback.
analysis: Report all pair deltas and descriptive medians/ranges. No population significance, active-loop total-cost, causal resource-pressure, cache-independence or durability-after-power-loss claim. Missing readings retain status. Stop on error or budget exhaustion; no retry selected for favorable outcomes.
authority: User requested continued habitat measurement and refinement; root-owned bounded standard-library code in existing writable environment.
